name: hud_ui_element_set_blt_source_and_clip_rect
description: HudUiElement::SetBltSourceAndClipRect stores the blit source and dispatches SetClipRect through the element virtual dispatch state.
known_limits: Tier C first; the existing VC target hud_ui_element_set_blt_source_and_clip_rect covers this function but may be blocked by the current zhud_ui.cpp VC compile issue.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4b4190 validate storing bltSourceOrNull at HudUiElement offset 0x1c, loading rectOrNull, and dispatching virtual slot offset 0x1c to SetClipRect with thiscall stack cleanup for two arguments.

The native element clip/invalidate smoke initializes base HUD dispatch state, calls SetBltSourceAndClipRect with a source pointer and rect, and verifies bltSource is stored and the clip rectangle is copied through SetClipRect.
